item.title: How I set up Claude Code for analytics engineering work
item.description: Most analytics engineers spend the first 5 minutes of every AI session re-explaining their stack. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and a handful of skills fix that permanently.

item.title: Why your dbt project has 47 models and nobody trusts any of them
item.description: The dbt trust problem isn't a tooling issue. It's an architectural and process problem — and it shows up in every data team that moved fast and skipped the governance layer.
